title: Disclosure 403-5 Worker training on occupational health and safety
topic: GRI 1: Foundation 2021 specifies the requirements that the organization must comply with to report in accordance
requirements: workers who are not employees but whose work and/or workplace is controlled by the
a. A description of any occupational health and safety training provided to workers,
including generic training as well as training on specific work-related hazards,
guidance: When describing the occupational health and safety training provided, the reporting organization
• how the training is designed and delivered, including the content or topics addressed, the
competency of trainers, which workers receive the training, the frequency of the training, and
whether the training is provided in a language easily understood by workers;
• whether the training is provided free of charge and during paid working hours – if not,
whether it is mandatory for workers to attend, and whether they are compensated for this;
• how the effectiveness of the training is evaluated.
